 Who is Jay Puri? The Indian-origin executive who may become Jensen Huang's successor at Nvidia
 SECTIONS Who is Jay Puri? The Indian-origin executive who may become Jensen Huang's successor at Nvidia By Anil Satapathy , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 05:31:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Jay Puri, a seasoned executive with Nvidia since 2005, has transitioned from his executive position to assume the role of senior adviser. With a notable academic foundation from institutions like the University of Minnesota, Caltech, and Harvard Business School, Puri has made significant contributions in various leadership roles. As discussions regarding Jensen Huang's potential succession gain momentum, Puri's credentials position him as a prominent figure.
 Jay Puri with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
 Amid speculations of Nvidia board preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang following reports of his affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and another colleague, several names have started emerging as potential successors to the chipmaker's long-time chief executive. Among those include the Indian-born Jay Puri , who spent more than two decades at Nvidia in senior leadership positions. Notably, Puri stepped down from his executive role in August 2026 and is now serving as a senior adviser to the company.
 Who is Jay Puri?
Jay Puri, whose full name is Ajay K. Puri, joined Nvidia in 2005 as Senior Vice President of Worldwide Sales. He was subsequently promoted to Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations, a position he held until his retirement from the executive role.
Before joining Nvidia, Puri spent 22 years at Sun Microsystems, where he held several senior leadership positions across sales, marketing and general management. His roles at Sun included Senior Vice President of the Asia-Pacific Group, Vice President of Worldwide Sales for Software and Technology, President of Nihon Sun KK and Vice President of Worldwide Product Marketing. 
Puri also worked at Hewlett-Packard, Booz Allen & Hamilton and Texas Instruments, gaining experience in marketing, management consulting and product development.
 Jay Puri's educational qualifications
Puri has a strong academic background in engineering and business management. He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering with high distinction from the University of Minnesota.
 Live Events
 He subsequently completed a Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) and an MBA from Harvard Business School.
 What was Jay Puri's role at Nvidia?
During his more than 21 years at Nvidia, Puri oversaw several critical business functions, including global sales, business development, customer engagement and technical support.
 His responsibilities involved managing Nvidia's relationships with customers and business partners across international markets. These operations became increasingly important as Nvidia expanded beyond its traditional graphics processing business into data centres, accelerated computing and artificial intelligence.
In June 2026, Nvidia announced Puri's retirement from his executive position, effective August 24, 2026. He was subsequently expected to continue working with the company as a senior adviser.
Reflecting on his time at the company, Puri then said: "My time at NVIDIA has been the defining chapter of my career. Witnessing the company’s evolution into a global leader—and having the opportunity to contribute to that journey—has been deeply meaningful."
"I am especially grateful to Jensen for his vision and leadership, and to the exceptional colleagues and partners around the world with whom I’ve had the privilege to work. The trust, collaboration, and shared ambition we built together are what I will value most. I look forward to continuing to support NVIDIA’s next phase of growth and innovation," he added in the LinkedIn post earlier this year.
 Could Jay Puri replace Jensen Huang?
Puri's long association with Nvidia and his experience managing its global business operations make him a notable figure in the company's leadership structure. However, for now, there has been no official announcement naming Puri as Huang's successor. Any discussion about a possible leadership change should therefore be treated as speculation rather than a confirmed succession plan.
